basic_details.short_information: The Meghalaya State Disaster Management Authority (MSDMA) has two contractual posts for its Mitigation Project Management Division (MPMD): Structural/Infrastructure Mitigation Specialist (Structural Engineer) and Assistant Structural Engineer. Send the application in the prescribed form to the Office of the Executive Director, SDMA, Lower Lachaumiere, Shillong -793001. It must be in on or before 6 November 2026 at 5 PM. MSDMA works under the Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Government of Meghalaya.

content_sections.heading: About MSDMA
content_sections.text: The Meghalaya State Disaster Management Authority is part of the Government of Meghalaya and works under the Revenue and Disaster Management Department. Its office is at Lower Lachaumiere, Shillong. Both posts are in its Mitigation Project Management Division (MPMD), which deals with structural mitigation projects funded under NDMF/SDMF.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The form is titled "Application Form for Specialist/Assistant in the Meghalaya State Disaster Management Authority (MSDMA)". It asks for: the post applied for and a recent passport-size photograph; your name in capital letters, your father's, mother's or spouse's name, sex, date of birth and age; your date of retirement, and your designation and department at retirement (if applicable); your category (SC/ST/OBC/General/Any Other), contact addresses and present occupation; your education and experience, both in reverse chronological order. The experience part covers the period (From/To), nature of work and accomplishments; trainings, publications (if any) and any other information; references (name, designation, institution, address, e-mail and phone number); a signed and dated declaration. In it you confirm that your information is correct and that the Selection Committee will check your documents for Essential Qualification and Work Experience at the time of selection. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: No other allowances will be paid on top of the fixed monthly amount for either post. Both posts are based at SDMA, Shillong. Qualification: Master's Degree (M.E./M.Tech) in Structural Engineering/ Earthquake Engineering/ Infrastructure Engineering/ Disaster Mitigation Engineering from a recognized university/institution. Experience: at least 1 year in the field, with knowledge of AutoCAD. Qualification: Bachelor's Degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Structural Engineering/ Earthquake Engineering/ Infrastructure Engineering/ Disaster Mitigation Engineering from a recognized university/institution. Experience: at least 1 year in the field, with knowledge of AutoCAD. The age limit in the eligibility criteria is 18 – 32 years. Both posts are contractual. The engagement is for 1 (one) year and may be extended or curtailed depending on requirement and satisfactory performance. The work is full-time. Those engaged may not take up any other assignment while engaged with SDMA. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

rows.pay: Fixed amount of Rs. 65,000/- per month
Fixed amount of Rs. 45,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: MSDMA Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide technical expertise in the planning, design, and implementation of structural mitigation projects funded under NDMF/SDMF. Preparation of Project Pre-Feasibility Reports including cost estimates. Conducting technical assessments, including geotechnical and hazard-specific studies, and recommend safe, resilient design solutions. Design of appropriate mitigation measures. Prepare/review/vet DPRs, drawings, and technical specifications for compliance with BIS/NBC/NDMA standards. Support quality control and monitoring during project execution. Document best practices, case studies, and technical reports for resilient infrastructure. Provide technical inputs for capacity-building workshops on structural mitigation and resilient construction practices. Any other matters as required by SDMA. To assist the Structural/Infrastructure Mitigation Specialist as per the scope of work. Any other matters as required by SDMA.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The application in the prescribed form at Annexure-I, with a recent passport-size photograph. Your resume. Self-attested copies of the relevant documents, including those for Essential Qualification and Work Experience.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: An Interview Committee makes the selection for both posts, and its decision is final and binding on all candidates. Your documents for Essential Qualification and Work Experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MSDMA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 for Structural/Infrastructure Mitigation Specialist (Structural Engineer) and 1 for Assistant Structural Engineer. The notice does not print a number for each post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MSDMA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted to the Office of the Executive Director, SDMA, Shillong on or before 6 November 2026 at 5 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the MSDMA Structural Engineer post?
faq.answer: You need a Master's Degree (M.E./M.Tech) in Structural Engineering/ Earthquake Engineering/ Infrastructure Engineering/ Disaster Mitigation Engineering from a recognized university/institution. You also need at least 1 year of experience in the field, with knowledge of AutoCAD.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the MSDMA Assistant Structural Engineer post?
faq.answer: You need a Bachelor's Degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Structural Engineering/ Earthquake Engineering/ Infrastructure Engineering/ Disaster Mitigation Engineering from a recognized university/institution. You also need at least 1 year of experience in the field, with knowledge of AutoCAD.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MSDMA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit in the eligibility criteria is 18 – 32 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the MSDMA posts?
faq.answer: The Structural/Infrastructure Mitigation Specialist (Structural Engineer) gets a fixed Rs. 65,000/- per month. The Assistant Structural Engineer gets a fixed Rs. 45,000/- per month. No other allowances are paid for either post.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for MSDMA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed form at Annexure-I and attach your resume and self-attested copies of the relevant documents. Submit it to the Office of the Executive Director, SDMA, Lower Lachaumiere, Shillong -793001 by 6 November 2026, 5 PM.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MSDMA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: An Interview Committee selects the candidates, and its decision is final and binding on all candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is the MSDMA job permanent?
faq.answer: No. Both posts are contractual and full-time, for 1 (one) year. The engagement may be extended or curtailed depending on requirement and satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Can I take up another job while working with MSDMA?
faq.answer: No. You will not be allowed to take up any other assignment while engaged with SDMA.
